observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Open-air coastal promenade next to a beach and ocean in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, with spectators watching a tall pole performance.
observation.dancers: Four adult male performers suspended in the air spinning, and one adult male performer standing at the top of the pole playing music.
observation.formation_and_space: Four dancers attached by ropes to a rotating frame at the top of a tall pole, circling horizontally as they descend; one dancer sits or stands atop the central pivot playing a flute and drum.
observation.posture: Dancers hang upside down or sideways, suspended horizontally by their ankles, keeping their bodies extended with arched backs while spinning.
observation.footwork: Feet are tied to ropes and do not touch the ground during the descent; legs are extended or slightly bent as they spin in mid-air.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms are extended outward to the sides or slightly bent while spinning in the air; the musician holds and plays a small flute and a small drum.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torsos are arched backwards and extended horizontally while suspended upside down in rotation.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: High vertical elevation on a tall pole; continuous rotational spinning while descending head-first toward the ground.
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional-style performance attire: white shirts, red trousers with decorative embroidery and sashes, feathered or decorated headbands, and ribbons attached to clothing; tall wooden pole with a rotating frame and ropes.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact weight distribution and footwork details cannot be seen as dancers are suspended in the air.

signature_moments.what: Four dancers suspended by their ankles from ropes attached to a high rotating frame, spinning in a circle head-down as they slowly descend.
